pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, dark brown polygons with highly jagged, stellate, or star-like edges. Sharp pixel gradients define the transition between patches and corridors. The spatial area of the patches dominates the visual field.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thin, off-white linear pathways forming a continuous reticulated grid. Junction nodes are primarily tri-directional intersections. Pixel thickness remains relatively constant across the visible flank and neck topology.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible dark mane along the upper neck contour exhibiting low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations against the background silhouette.
